engine_room_master.purpose: Primary recurring environment for the Tiny Engine Cadet series

visual_identity.space: modern merchant ship engine room, multi-level industrial machinery space
visual_identity.architecture: steel decks, grated walkways, ladders, pipes, valves, cable trays, handrails and large marine machinery arranged plausibly
visual_identity.palette: navy, steel gray, off-white machinery housings, restrained safety yellow accents
visual_identity.lighting: clean practical industrial lighting with soft cinematic contrast; readable faces and machinery
visual_identity.atmosphere: slight warm machinery haze, clean but actively operated ship, no dramatic smoke unless technically justified
visual_identity.scale: characters appear miniature and cute, but machinery retains believable marine-engine proportions
forbidden_changes: no logos or readable company branding
no unsafe missing guardrails where a real platform requires them
no excessive steam, sparks, fire or smoke unless the story explicitly requires a fault

camera_language: medium and medium-wide shots for dialogue
close-up inserts for valves, gauges, separators and tools
maintain screen direction and spatial continuity between adjacent scenes
